metadata.title: jam-actions-v1 — AI Jam Sessions tool-use traces (shown-work targets)
metadata.description: 146 multi-turn MCP tool-use traces over 11 public-domain piano pieces whose arrangements carry a verified licence, nine task families, split by song. Every assistant turn shows the comparison that decides its answer. Built under a seven-rule experiment contract; rebuilt nine times as each training run — and finally a provenance audit — exposed what the previous version let through. CC-BY-SA-3.0-DE.
metadata.notes: New version under the concept DOI; prior jam-actions-v0 deposits are unchanged. Gate clearance is not release approval.
